description: Land transfer tax on a residential purchase (1–2 single-family residences; not commercial, 3+ unit or vacant/farm land) in all 13 provinces/territories (incl. Toronto MLTT, Montreal welcome tax), first-time buyer rebates, the transfer registration fee and total due at registration. AB, SK, NL and the territories charge only the registration fee. Mortgage registration fee not included.

inToronto.description: Ontario only: property is within the City of Toronto (adds the municipal LTT)

quebecMunicipality.description: Quebec only: 'montreal' = Montreal's welcome-tax brackets (default); 'other' = provincial base schedule, for municipalities without higher rates above $500,000
